name: Glass‑Root Mangrove Sanctuary
description: Mangrove roots made of clear glass, glowing with internal bioluminescence, sheltering luminous fish.
prompt: Coastal mangrove swamp where the tangled roots are transparent glass tubes filled with swirling bioluminescent algae in blues and greens. Small glowing fish dart among the roots. Water surface perfectly mirrors the scene. Twilight sky with first stars. High detail, refractive lighting, serene mood.
caption: Roots that glow, waters that know 🌿💙 #GlassMangroves
